description:
About ten sites clone a whole Descr (five clause vectors plus finite sets) to read a few Ty ids, because a &Descr from the arena blocks the interning the walk does next.
Not forced at all: src/compiler2/types/arrow_match.rs:455 self.descr(pattern).clone().vars.values... (out is a separate &mut HashSet).
Forced by arena growth, src/compiler2/types/mod.rs: :1586 convergence_class, :1636 convergence_class_at, :4839-4840 collect_subst_into, :4687-4688 refine_widen_uncached (plus .pure_tuple().cloned(), .pure_arrow().cloned() and captures cloned twice at :4737-4739), :4777-4782 instantiate (d cloned, then d.clone() again for base); arrow_match.rs:616 tuple_positive_alternatives.
Shape: compute-then-commit. Read the small thing (tuple elems, list elem, record fields, vars) and then recurse.
Out of scope: intersect (:2158-2159), and any change to the arena itself. If id-only reads do not suffice for a site, leave it and report.
Heat: per type node, per template instantiation / per activation key derivation / per widened position.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
title: Type walks read ids out of a descriptor without cloning it
